examples.title: Card with nested blocks
examples.markup: <tmt-ui-block-document><tmt-ui-block label="Card" kind="card"><tmt-ui-card-block heading="A long card title wraps, and its meta follows on the right or drops below" meta="2 blocks"><tmt-ui-block label="Paragraph"><tmt-ui-text-block>A paragraph in the card.</tmt-ui-text-block></tmt-ui-block><tmt-ui-block label="Callout" kind="callout"><tmt-ui-callout>A callout in the card.</tmt-ui-callout></tmt-ui-block></tmt-ui-card-block></tmt-ui-block></tmt-ui-block-document>

examples.title: Section: a label, no frame
examples.markup: <tmt-ui-block-document><tmt-ui-block label="Section" kind="card"><tmt-ui-card-block variant="section" heading="Section"><tmt-ui-text-block>Only a label heading and no frame.</tmt-ui-text-block></tmt-ui-card-block></tmt-ui-block></tmt-ui-block-document>
